output.headline: Only Blackstone and TPG Capital span both lists; Health IT sponsors clear their target return at the ask, while Dental sponsors do not.
sentences: Only two buyers sit on both lists, Blackstone and TPG Capital, so the two universes barely overlap and each target needs its own outreach. [Q:shared]
Blackstone is High on both targets, while TPG Capital is Medium for Health IT but High for Dental, because its median deal of $88M is under half the $300M EV. [Q:shared, Q:target_a]

Health IT adds Evolent Health, a High strategic, and Francisco Partners, a Medium sponsor; Dental adds High strategics Heartland Dental and Aspen Dental (ADMI) and High sponsors Hellman & Friedman, General Atlantic, Welsh Carson. [Q:only_a, Q:only_b]
Health IT's defensible multiple is 21.4x and sponsors clear their 20% target return at the ask; Dental's is 15.4x and sponsors do not clear 20%. [Q:target_a, Q:target_b]
